name: Studnice (Třebíč District, Czechia)
description: Three horizontal stripes of yellow, blue and yellow in the ratio 1:6:1, with a crayfish counterchanged red and white between two curved charges in the blue.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 27 February 2004 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
